@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+# .github/workflows/ci-caller.yml
+name: Phase 1 - CI Build
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [ "main" ]
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [ "main" ]
+
+jobs:
+  # The name of this job ("build-pipeline") becomes part of the final check name!
+  build-pipeline:
+    uses: nelsong6/infra-bootstrap/.github/workflows/ci-template.yml@main
+    with:
+      backend_directory: './backend'
+      image_name_suffix: 'workout-api'
+      node_version: '20'
+    secrets: inherit

@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+# .github/workflows/cd-caller.yml
+name: Phase 3 - CD Deploy
+
+on:
+  repository_dispatch:
+    types: [spacelift_infra_ready]
+
+jobs:
+  call-deployment-template:
+    # Point this to wherever you store your centralized workflows
+    uses: nelsong6/infra-bootstrap/.github/workflows/deploy-template.yml@main
+    with:
+      # Extract the SHA from the webhook and pass it as an input
+      target_sha: ${{ github.event.client_payload.commit_sha }}
+    secrets: inherit

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+name: Reset Spacelift on PR Merge
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [closed]
+
+jobs:
+  # GitHub fires the "closed" event for BOTH merged and unmerged (abandoned) PRs.
+  # We use this if-condition to ensure it only runs if the PR was actually merged.
+  reset-spacelift:
+    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true
+    uses: your-org/your-shared-repo/.github/workflows/spacelift-reset-branch.yml@main
+    with:
+      spacelift_endpoint: 'https://your-tenant.app.spacelift.io'
+      target_branch: 'main'
+    secrets:
+      spacelift_api_key_id: ${{ secrets.SPACELIFT_API_KEY_ID }}
+      spacelift_api_key_secret: ${{ secrets.SPACELIFT_API_KEY_SECRET }}
